about_the_game:
Easy View is a visual design and project planning tool, extensively utilized in industries like architecture, film production, and game development. It offers highly realistic 3D models and animations, enabling users to intuitively visualize the final look of a project. This assists in refining creative choices and streamlining production processes.

The software boasts a comprehensive suite of features, including real-time rendering, lighting simulation, material editing, and camera configuration. It facilitates team collaboration and supports the import and export of various file formats, greatly improving communication and visualization of projects. Moreover, Easy View incorporates virtual reality (VR) technology, offering an immersive experience that enhances design precision and client satisfaction.

short_description: EasyView is a 3D simulation game that lets players act as directors and producers. With a user-friendly interface, they can create and rehearse movies, TV shows, and music videos, utilizing features like real-time rendering and dynamic lighting to bring their creative visions to life.
